column1: # The lines of a server, as every program takes them: adhoc-relay-server.pl and .ps1, adhoc-remotedesk --meet ( AdHoc RemoteDesk ), a DeFreez host
# ( Me.Mirror.meet ). A copy of this file lies in each of them; their tests read it. One line a case: the line, a tab, what it is -
# the line whole, with the signs of the keyboard ( 👉 >, 🌐 @ ) and the ports put in where the line has none -, or `error`.
# <key>👉<relay>:<port>                         a fixed port: the key knocks at once
# <password>👉<relay>[:<port>]👉                 a port given at each start: 👉 at the end - an answer comes
#                                              the address of the relay read at its keepers, in turn; the port is of the relay
# A password, a key, a read key: 16 letters and digits. A relay, a keeper: a name or an IPv4 address, none of : @ = , ! ? > or a
# space in it. A port: 1…65535; none after a relay of a password - 40000, the first port AdHoc Relay installs. A fixed port, a keeper
# and a relay whose address is read name their ports. Spaces around the line and around each read go. 👉 and 🌐 may be typed as > and
# @; a 👉 with a colour of skin, and the sign that makes an emoji coloured, are the same.
